title: Prompt engineering: same facts, a structured ask
sub: Add a role, a fixed format and one worked example to the same question and source passage.

steps.h: The question and a source passage arrive
steps.d:
"What is the DW-480's drain pump part number and price?"
passage: "...HLV-2205, available through authorized
service...priced at $52.00..."

steps.h: Your code adds a role, a fixed format, and one worked example
steps.d:
SYSTEM You are a parts-desk assistant. Answer in exactly this format: PART: PRICE:

Example: 'heating element is HLV-4471, $38.50' -> PART: HLV-4471 PRICE: $38.50
